Rashi on Sotah 49a:10:1.hebrew: דחינוניתא - שמינה ויש בה ריח טוב, ומין תמרים הוא לעצמן:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:10:1.english: Of chinunita - [It is] fat and has a pleasant aroma, and it is a species of dates of its own.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:10:2.english: There is purity in you - Therefore [the date] is fragrant to you, and the fragrance has not ceased from you.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:10:3.english: His son came - [The son] of Rabbah bar Rav Huna.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:10:4.hebrew: א"ל - רב הונא לבריה:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:10:4.english: He said to him - Rav Huna [said this] to his son.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:10:5.english: You have made my heart rejoice - With your purity.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:10:6.hebrew: והקהיתה את שיני - שהראיתני שאהבתך על בנך יותר מעלי, שנטלת ממני ונתת לו:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:10:6.english: And you have blunted my teeth - For you have shown me that your love for your son is greater than [your love] for me, in that you took [it] from me and gave [it] to him.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:11:1.english: Took care of him - He raised him in his house.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:11:2.hebrew: רבי רבי - גדל, גדל אותי, ואע"פ כן איני בנך:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:11:2.english: Rabi, rabi - Raise, raise me, and even so, I am not your son.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:11:3.english: I am the son of your daughter - And it is not incumbent upon me to honor you like a son.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:12:1.english: In the war [pulemus] - [An] army that Vespasian brought against Jerusalem.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:12:2.english: Crowns of bridegrooms and irus - [This is] explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:13:1.hebrew: בפולמוס של טיטוס - שהביא הורקנוס אאריסתובלוס אחיו, ובין זה לזה היו חמשים ושתים שנה, כדאמר בסדר עולם:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:13:1.english: In the war of Titus - Whom Hyrcanus brought against Aristobulus, his brother; and between this [war] and that [war] there were fifty-two years, as it says in Seder Olam.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:13:2.english: Crowns of brides - [This] is explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:14:1.hebrew: בפולמוס האחרון - הוא של חורבן הבית, ושל טיטוס נמי הוה:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:14:1.english: In the last war - It is [the war] of the destruction of the Temple, and [the war] of Titus was also [part of it].

Rashi on Sotah 49a:14:2.hebrew: באפריון בתוך העיר - שהיו מוליכין אותה מבית אביה לבית בעלה, ואפריון של מעילים וטליתות מוזהבות מוקפות לה:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:14:2.english: In a palanquin inside the city - For they would escort her from her father's house to her husband's house, and a palanquin [is made] of cloaks and gilded garments surrounding her.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:1.hebrew: מושלי משלות - לתת אות, אמתלא וטעם לחכמה, ליכנס בה בשערי בינה, כגון ממשלות שועלים; דאמר בסנהדרין (דף לח:): כי הוה דריש ר"מ בפירקא, הוה דריש תילתא שמעתא ותילתא אגדתא ותילתא מתלי:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:1.english: Speakers of parables - To give a sign, a pretext, and a reason for wisdom, to enter through it into the gates of understanding, such as fox fables; as it says in Sanhedrin (38b): When Rabbi Meir would lecture at the public discourse, he would lecture a third [in] halakhic teachings, a third [in] aggadah, and a third [in] parables.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:2.hebrew: שקדנים - שוקדין על דלתות בית המדרש לילה ויום, כדאמר ביבמות (דף סג:), "אבל מה אעשה שנפשי חשקה בתורה":
Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:2.english: The diligent - [Those who] attend diligently at the doors of the study hall night and day, as he said in Yevamot (63b): "But what can I do, for my soul desires the Torah."

Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:3.hebrew: הדרשנים - שהיה בקי בטעמי המקראות, כדאמר: ״לא זכיתי שתאמר יציאת מצרים בלילות עד שדרשה בן זומא״ (ברכות דף יב:):
Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:3.english: The exegetists - For [ben Zoma] was expert in the meanings of the Scriptural verses, as [Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah] said: "I did not merit that the Exodus from Egypt be recited at night until ben Zoma expounded it" (Berakhot 12b).

Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:4.hebrew: בטל כבוד תורה - שהיה נותן לבו לדרוש כל קוץ וקוץ של כל אות, וכ"ש תיבות יתירות ואותיות יתירות, כגון בת ובת אני דורש (סנהדרין דף נא:), וזהו כבוד תורה גדול, שאין בה דבר לבטלה:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:4.english: The honor of the Torah ceased - For he would set his heart to expound every single tittle of every letter, and all the more so superfluous words and superfluous letters, such as "I expound 'daughter' and 'and daughter'" (Sanhedrin 51b). And this is a great honor to the Torah, that there is nothing in it in vain.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:5.hebrew: אנשי מעשה - בטוח בחשיבותו ועושה מעשים מופלאים, כדאמר בתענית (דף כה.): נמטי כשוריך, יאמר לחומץ וידלוק, ולעזים להביא זאבים בקרניהם:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:5.english: Men of action - [One who is] confident in his worthiness and performs wondrous deeds, as it says in Ta'anit (25a): "May your beams reach"; "He will tell vinegar to burn"; and [he told] the goats to bring wolves on their horns.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:6.hebrew: קטנותם של חסידים - שהיו החסידים הולכים וכלים, והוא היה מקטניהם וסופן:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:15:6.english: The smallest of the pious - Because the pious were progressively diminishing, and he was among the smallest of them and their end.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:16:1.english: The glory of wisdom - I do not know what this is.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:16:2.hebrew: משמת ר"ג הזקן בטל כבוד התורה - במסכת מגילה (דף כא.) אמר שעד שמת הוא היה בריאות בעולם, ולא היו למידין תורה אלא מעומד. משמת הוא, ירד חולי לעולם והוצרכו ללמוד תורה מיושב:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:16:2.english: From [the time] when Rabban Gamliel the Elder died, the honor of the Torah ceased - In Tractate Megillah (21a), [the Gemara] states that until he died, there was health in the world and they would only study Torah while standing; once he died, illness descended upon the world and they had to study Torah while sitting.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:16:3.english: The glory of the priesthood ceased - For he was wise and wealthy, and many priests would eat at his table.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:17:1.english: And free men - [Those of] noble lineage.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:17:2.hebrew: חפו ראשם - שגברה יד עזי פנים ממזרים, שהם עשירים ואלו עניים. נדלדלו אנשי מעשה — אין חש להם:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:17:2.english: Their heads were covered - For the hand of brazen-faced mamzerim prevailed, as they are wealthy while these [the ḥaverim and free men] are poor. Men of action dwindled — no one pays heed to them.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:17:4.english: And none ask - [for] mercy for them.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:19:1.english: Scholars have begun - The Sages began.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:19:2.english: Scribes - Teachers of children, who are lesser than the Sages.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:19:3.english: Like amma de'ar'a - Like amei ha'aretz [ignoramuses].

Rashi on Sotah 49a:1:1.hebrew: שמבזבזין דין אביהם - קורעים דין אביהם, שכשבאין לדונם אומרים לפניו וכו':
Rashi on Sotah 49a:1:1.english: Who plunder their father’s judgment - They tear up their father’s judgment, for when [the Heavenly court] comes to judge them, [the children] say before Him, etc.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:1:2.hebrew: הקהיתה שיניהם - למה האבלתם וצערתם עלינו במותינו, ונפרעת מהם בחייהם:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:1:2.english: You blunted their teeth - Why did You cause them to mourn and grieve over us through our deaths, and exact punishment from them in their lifetimes?

Rashi on Sotah 49a:2:1.hebrew: מוכרי רבב - רבב הוא דבר מאוס, כגון חלב ושומן, ונדבק בבגדים ונמאסין, ואין לך אדם מתעסק בהם אלא עני:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:2:1.english: Sellers of fat [revav] - Revav is a repulsive substance, such as tallow and fat, and it clings to garments and they become repulsive, and no one deals with them except a poor person.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:2:2.hebrew: שיתה ה' מורה להם - לעיל מיניה כתיב: "כי לא לנצח ישכח אביון תקות ענוים תאבד לעד", "שיתה ה' מורה להם" — תן להם מרות לאותן עניים — עושר, שיהו הגוים נוהגין בהם כבוד, וידעו הגוים שהן אנוש ואינם אלהות, שאין כל הכבוד והגדולה שלהם:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:2:2.english: Place for them mastery, O Lord - Above it, it is written: "For the needy shall not always be forgotten, [nor] the hope of the poor perish forever" [Psalms 9:19], "Place for them mastery, O Lord" [Psalms 9:21] — give them authority — to those poor people — [namely,] wealth, so that the nations will treat them with honor, and the nations will know that they [themselves] are [mere] mortals and are not deities, for all honor and greatness are not theirs.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:2:3.english: Cover themselves with one cloak - Because of poverty.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:2:4.hebrew: בקרב שנים - אותה פעולה שלך, דהיינו דבר תורה, שהיא בקירוב שנים, ששנים צריכין להתקרב יחד בכיסוי אחד:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:2:4.english: In the midst of the years - That work of Yours, that is, the matter of Torah, which is in the closeness of two, for two [scholars] need to draw close together in one covering.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:2:5.english: Revive it - Heal it, and grant them relief, and give them their livelihood.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:3:1.hebrew: המה הולכים הלוך ודבר - בדברי תורה. באליהו ובאלישע כתיב:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:3:1.english: They walked along, talking - [That is, talking] about words of Torah. [This verse] is written regarding Elijah and Elisha.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:3:2.english: Deserving of being burned - For it was for that purpose that the chariot of fire came upon them.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:4:1.hebrew: אחד מת - ע"י חבירו שהרגו בשוגג, וזה גולה לערי מקלט. ואם אין כאן מיתה, סימן למיתה וגלות סימן לגלות, שאחד מת ואחד גולה:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:4:1.english: One dies - By the hand of his fellow, who killed him unintentionally, and this one is exiled to the cities of refuge. And if there is no death here, [it is] a sign of death, and exile [is] a sign of exile — that one dies and one is exiled.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:4:2.english: Without knowledge - Because they did not have the knowledge to teach one another and learn from one another.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:4:3.english: My people are destroyed - And the end of the verse [is]: "And you have forgotten the Torah of your God."

Rashi on Sotah 49a:5:1.hebrew: כי עם בציון ישב - אלו יושבי ישיבת תורה, וסיפא דקרא — חנון יחנך לקול זעקך:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:5:1.english: For, O people that dwells in Zion - These are those who sit in the academy of Torah [study], and the end of the verse [states]: "He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry."

Rashi on Sotah 49a:5:2.hebrew: לחם צר - במי הכתוב מדבר? במי שמזונותיו קשין עליו, ואעפ"כ יושב ועוסק בתורה:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:5:2.english: Sparse bread - Of whom does Scripture speak? Of one whose sustenance is difficult for him [to obtain], and even so, he sits and engages in Torah [study].

Rashi on Sotah 49a:6:1.english: And your eyes, etc. - And similarly, after it, it is written: "And [your Teacher] shall not hide [Himself]."

Rashi on Sotah 49a:6:3.english: [He] shall not hide Himself - He will not cover Himself from you with the corner of His garment and His partition.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:7:1.english: Of tomorrow - Would that [the] day come.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:7:2.english: Does he know - whether it will be better than the night?

Rashi on Sotah 49a:7:3.english: Rather, [the morning] that has passed - Would that this coming day were like this one that passed.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:8:1.english: But why does the world exist - Since the curse is continually increasing.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:8:2.hebrew: אקדושה דסידרא - סדר קדושה, שלא תקנוה אלא שיהו כל ישראל עוסקין בתורה בכל יום דבר מועט, שאומר קריאתו ותרגומו, והן כעוסקין בתורה. וכיון שנוהג בכל ישראל — בתלמידים ובעמי הארץ — ויש כאן שתים, קדושת השם ותלמוד התורה, חביב הוא. וכן יהא שמיה רבה מברך שעונין אחר הגדה שהדרשן דורש ברבים — בכל שבת היו נוהגין כך, ושם היו נקבצין כל העם לשמוע לפי שאינו יום של מלאכה — ויש כאן תורה וקידוש השם:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:8:2.english: By the sanctification of the order - The order of Kedushah, which they instituted only so that all of Israel would engage in Torah every day [for] a small amount, for one recites its [Scriptural] reading and its translation, and they are [thereby] like those who engage in Torah. And since it is practiced among all of Israel — among scholars and among the unlearned — and there are two [things] here, the sanctification of the Name and the study of Torah, it is beloved. And similarly, "Yehei shemei rabba mevorach" ["May His great name be blessed"], which they respond after the Aggadah that the preacher expounds in public — every Shabbat they were accustomed to do so, and there all the people would gather to listen, since it is not a day of work — and there are [both] Torah and the sanctification of the Name here.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:8:3.english: Orders - Orders of the sections of the Torah.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:9:2.hebrew: ביטלה טעם - הפירות וריחם, שמתוך שהיו טהורים ונוהגין בטהרה, אף הקב"ה מטהר פירותיהן מריח רע ומטעם רע:
Rashi on Sotah 49a:9:2.english: [It] has abolished the taste - of the fruits and their aroma, for since they were pure and conducted themselves in purity, the Holy One, blessed be He, would also purify their fruits from bad odor and from bad taste.

Rashi on Sotah 49a:9:3.hebrew: מעשר ביטל שומן דגן - בעון פיסוק מעשרות, פסק שומן הדגן, כשמו של מעשר דאיקרי חלב, כדכתיב כל חלב יצהר וגו' (במדבר י״ח:י״ב):
Rashi on Sotah 49a:9:3.english: Tithes have removed the fat of grain - Because of the sin of ceasing [to give] tithes, the fat of the grain ceased, like the name of the tithe, which is called "fat" [chelev], as it is written: "All the fat [best] of the oil, etc." (Numbers 18:12).
